scope: Unadopted stage-aware RT01–RT06 attempt and per-installation aggregate operation/touch/journal-stage custody; preserves prior profiles unchanged.

accounting.custodyAdmission: Reserve complete worst-case bounded original custody before first canonical writer submission; preserve aggregate reservation through generation/appended-operation updates. A late growth failure rolls back the governing operation under its original containment, never drops earlier obligations.
accounting.rowBytes: Count every original carrier occurrence in operation and touch rows, decoded snapshots, wire artifacts, transfer/disposition/closure/capacity evidence, and result/archive copies. Shared identity/hash does not eliminate actual copies. The 8-MiB per-row original cap does not exempt that row from 16-MiB aggregate selected/decoded evidence or 128-MiB peak ownership; envelope/base64/native transport expansion has separate pre-materialization admission.
accounting.persistentCapacity: Account actual retained rows/bytes and in-flight reservations under qualified native exclusion; concurrent writers cannot spend the same remaining capacity. Full native storage/index/WAL overhead needs its separately selected deployment budget.
accounting.collection: Count repeated original source/artifact/dependency decode, collision comparisons, RT04 recollection, transfer/receipt buffers and complete deleted-identity inventory. Field transport is bounded before full host allocation.
accounting.work: Charge every observed row/reference/allocation plus every byte hashed/decoded/copied/compared; exact settlement/archive codecs have additionally selected weights.
accounting.saturation: Refuse new reservation without eviction; existing unsettled original recovery and already admitted obligations remain retained. Cleanup does not infer expiration from age or storage pressure.
accounting.capacityRelease: Release persistent source custody only after actual cleanup commit or exact original reconciliation plus discharged archive/recovery dependencies; release working reservations only after actual native/worker containment.
accounting.deadline: Minimum of 30-second stage and governing administrative deadline, monotonically measured from admission; lock/native/worker limits separately pinned.
accounting.maxima: Individual bounds are not a simultaneous-fit or successful-throughput guarantee; exceeding any bound refuses the whole attempt.
accounting.operationRegistry: Operation, touch and journal-stage rows share aggregate retained row/byte and in-flight reservation caps under one selected native ledger. Stage bodies and duplicated parent/prestate/candidate/event/origin bytes count every actual occurrence; distinct registries or hashes do not create separate allowances.
accounting.rowMembership: The existing 512 selected-row cap counts every parent, touch and stage row in complete original dependency closure. A selected operation and all its stages form one indivisible cohort; no truncation, partial-prefix selection or child-only eviction to fit. Reobserved and returned copies charge work/evidence/allocation ledgers independently.
accounting.stageBytes: Count exact body_bytes plus original xid/ordinal/phase/generation transport and snapshot/cohort/result/archive/evidence occurrences. For N body bytes, lowercase hex alone occupies 2*N transport bytes before JSON envelope; charge raw native bytes, hex, decoded bytes, parser tree and canonical regeneration as actual simultaneous/cumulative copies. Nested base64 components retain their own separately admitted expansion; no double-count exemption by shared artifact identity.
accounting.wholeOperationFit: Before stage admission or growth, prove at least one complete selected parent/stage/dependency cleanup cohort fits every selected cleanup/canonical/transport/work/peak bound. The 8-MiB per-row upper bound is not a promise of 16-MiB selected-evidence fit. If no complete one-operation cohort fits, refuse the governing operation before effects or contain its growth failure; preserve prior obligations and unknown settlement.
accounting.stageCapacityRelease: Pending child/parent DELETE does not release persistent occupancy. Retain unresolved original reservations until actual complete cleanup settlement or qualified original reconciliation; rollback restores all stage/parent/capacity/evidence effects together. Spent processing and allocator consumption are never refunded as occupancy.

adoption: Select coherent original writer/staging/cleanup/phase/cohort/result codecs, native shared ledger/exclusion/descriptor/transport and archive/settlement profiles; independently qualify whole-operation fit, concurrent reservation, exact/one-over bounds, large fields, rollback and unknown outcomes. Numeric maxima are review proposals, not installed accounting.
